## Overview

Follow up to and stacked on top of https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63219. Avoid introducing pipeline bubbles when `step_with_batch_queue`  is used with structured outputs

## Claims


TODO

## Validation



https://gist.github.com/yzong-rh/e15dc602fbfd11e2b64c2d41527a1a72

Qwen/Qwen3-4B + RedHatAI/Qwen3-4B-speculator.dspark + 8 draft tokens + async scheduling + structured outputs.
Ran on 1 B200.

```
.venv/bin/python run.py --output ... --pipeline-parallel-size ... --num-repeats 10
```

Results report throughput in tokens/s.
- broad vs tight constraints: less vocab masked vs more vocab masked
- c1 vs c96: low vs high concurrency
- 95% confidence intervals in brackets

Workload | Concurrency | Baseline | Target | Target change | p-value
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --
broad | 1 | 1023.5 [1020.9, 1026.1] | 1035.3 [1033.4, 1037.2] | +1.15% | 6.26e-9
broad | 96 | 14917.1 [14450.5, 15383.6] | 15976.3 [15891.0, 16061.5] | +7.10% | 1.41e-4
tight | 1 | 1561.9 [1556.9, 1566.9] | 1578.8 [1575.9, 1581.8] | +1.08% | 8.95e-7
tight | 96 | 28549.6 [27854.7, 29244.6] | 30203.9 [30084.4, 30323.4] | +5.79% | 8.32e-5
